title: Hussain ki aankhein
body:
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
[MasaeboN ka samandar] ×2 Hussein(as) ki aakheiN
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
Baad e Abbas e Alamdaar(as) Lag raha hai mujhe
Khuda ne isiliye binai lii thi Sarwar(as) se
[Na dekheiN laasha e Akbar] ×2 Hussein(as) ki aakheiN
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
ZameeN pe aagaye ghode se shahe jinn o bashar
Lahu mei duube hai teeroN se chalni tan hai magar
[Tiki hai khaime ke dar par] ×2 Hussein(as) ki aakhein
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
Hai sar Hussein(as) ka zanu e Fatema(sa) pe rakha
Kabhi hai dekhti nazre batool(sa) ka chehra
[Kabhi hai dekhti khanjar] ×2 Hussein(as) ki aakheiN
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
Ali(as) ki beti ke chehre ko surkhuru karne
Jo raaheiN Shaam mei Zainab(sa) ke sar pe girte the
[Na bhool paayi woh patthar] ×2 Hussein(as) ki aakhein
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
Nigah waris e tatheer se hatate huwe
SinaN ki nook pe Qur’an ko sunate huwe
[Thi dekhti rahi chaadar] ×2  Hussein(as) ki aakheiN
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
Jab aaya shaam ke zindaN mei sar Raza Sheh ka
Sakina(sa) ro ke dikha ti thi neel gaalo ka
[Na khul saki thi WahaaN par] ×2 Hussein(as) ki aakhein
(Har ek gham mei huwi tar Hussein(as) ki aakheiN) x2
